rounds.text: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd trades at a modest P/E of 15.3x [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of 2.77x [E2], backed by stellar profitability metrics including a 24.2% ROCE [E12] and an 18.8% ROE [E13], which comfortably exceed the sector median ROCE of 12.2% [E66]. The company demonstrates exceptional cash generation capabilities, posting Rs 101 Cr in free cash flow and operating cash flow for March 2026 [E28, E29], representing a cash conversion of 1.09x where profits are fully backed by cash [E27]. Earnings momentum is remarkably robust, highlighted by a 22% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E19] and a dramatic quarterly operating margin expansion of +6 percentage points to 11% in June 2026 compared to 5% in the year-ago quarter [E24]. Furthermore, the discounted cash flow model suggests a massive intrinsic value of Rs 734 per share against the current market price of Rs 285 [E38], leaving a substantial margin of safety of 61.2% [E39], while a reverse DCF indicates the current market price merely prices in a modest 5.0% earnings growth compared to the 18.0% assumed in the base case [E40]. Institutional sponsorship is strengthening alongside these fundamentals, with domestic institutions increasing their stake to 15.44% in June 2026 from 11.22% in September 2025 [E36], driving a positive institutional money flow signal [E37] and placing the stock above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E43]. Conceded: compounded sales growth over the past five years has stalled at just 1% [E14], and promoter holding remains low at 32.10% [E34].
